#23090
(NTRO DME
MAY 29,2076
ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all of the RS3 Residential Single-
Unit (Detached-House) District symbols and indications as shown on Map
No. 11-G in the area bounded by

The public alley next north of and parallel to West Warner Avenue, A line
104.60 feet west of and parallel to North Southport Avenue, West Warner
Avenue, and a line190.60 feet west of and parallel to North Southport
Avenue

to those of a RM4.5 Residential Multi-Unit District.

Section 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its
passage and due publication.

Common Address of Property: 1410-12 W. Warner Avenue
